NOTE for TextEdit: New documents are rich text and save as .rtf. If the task wants a plain .txt file, first choose Format ▸ Make Plain Text (answer OK if it asks). File ▸ Save… opens a save SHEET in this window. Choosing the folder: press_key cmd+shift+g while the sheet is open (keys are routed to the panel), then set_value the PathTextField to the folder path; the 'Where:' popup must then show that folder's name (press_key return if it doesn't). Then set_value the saveAsNameTextField to the file name and click the sheet's Save button. Setting a field's value can by itself trigger the panel's default action — always read the CHANGES before your next step. If a 'replace existing file?' alert appears, it is another sheet in the same window. Saved means ALL of: the sheet is gone, the window title is the file name, the title bar no longer says Edited, and the server reports 'DISK: … was written'. File ▸ Duplicate opens an unsaved copy in a NEW window; save that one — the original window keeps the original file.
